slides.texte_overlay:
5 Badass signs you're
on the right path

You wake up without
dreading the day.

Not every day is easy.
But it's yours.

Your friends push you.

They ask what you're building,
not where you're drinking.

You're curious again.

You look things up.
You ask why.
Learning feels good.
slides.texte_sophia:
You're curious again.

You look things up on the
Sophia app. Learning feels good.

slides.texte_overlay:
You keep promises to yourself.

The workout, the early night,
the hard call.

Old drama bores you.

You have better things to do.
